objects.taxonomy_description: Swift leporid mammal measuring 45-70 cm body length with elongated body and powerful hind limbs. Fur dense in brown, gray, or seasonal white coloration. Ears exceptionally long (10-15 cm) with black tips. Hind legs massively elongated with muscular thighs enabling rapid leaping at speeds exceeding 60 km/h. Forelegs shorter. Tail short. Young born precocial with full fur coat and open eyes. Inherited mammal traits include endothermy, fur insulation, mammary glands, and four-chambered heart. Timid behavior with cryptic resting posture. Larger than rabbit with longer ears and legs.

Head_and_Face: Exceptionally long ears with black tips, markedly longer than rabbit ears.

Dense fur in brown, gray, or seasonal white coloration.
Larger than rabbit with longer ears and legs.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Massively elongated hind legs with muscular thighs enabling rapid leaping.

objects.taxonomy_description: Bowed stringed instrument with a curved wooden body approximately 35 cm long. Body has an hourglass shape with C-bouts (inward curves) on each side. Top plate (soundboard) is spruce with two f-shaped sound holes. Back plate is maple with a distinctive flame pattern. Four strings (G, D, A, E) run from a tailpiece at the base over a bridge to tuning pegs in the scroll. Neck extends from the body to a carved scroll at the top. Fingerboard is ebony (black). Varnish finish is amber, reddish-brown, or golden. Chin rest is attached at the lower left. Bow is a wooden stick with horsehair.
